data.title: The missing envelope

memoryNodes.cueZh: 玛雅承认自己做过什么。

memoryNodes.cue: Reputation is connected with honest conduct.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 声誉与诚实行为相联系。

data.situation:
After lunch, Maya could not find the envelope that held the empty collection forms. She remembered moving it while clearing the desk. It was an ordinary mistake, but she felt embarrassed. Jo had a sensible suggestion: check the drawer before calling the whole team. The envelope was there, under a stack of leaflets. Maya took responsibility for putting it in the wrong place and wrote its location beside the desk record. Maya: I respect how carefully you keep these records.
Jo: They belong to everyone who helps here.
Maya: I was afraid I would be blamed.
Jo: We need honesty more than a perfect performance. Integrity matters when people trust us with their money.
Maya: I will tell the next person where the envelope is.
Jo: That is a respectful way to hand over the desk. A newspaper cutting on the wall called the charity a respectable organisation. Jo said a good reputation was something it had to keep earning. Maya looked again at the small box and understood why even the empty forms mattered.

readingBlocks.en: After lunch, Maya could not find the envelope that held the empty collection forms. She remembered moving it while clearing the desk. It was an ordinary mistake, but she felt embarrassed. Jo had a sensible suggestion: check the drawer before calling the whole team. The envelope was there, under a stack of leaflets. Maya took responsibility for putting it in the wrong place and wrote its location beside the desk record.
readingBlocks.zh: 午饭后，玛雅找不到装着空白募款表格的信封。她记得自己清理桌面时移动过它。这是一个普通失误，却让她尴尬。乔有个明智建议：先查抽屉，再召集整个团队。信封就在一叠传单下面。玛雅为放错地方承担责任，把它的位置记在桌面记录旁。

readingBlocks.zh:
玛雅：我很敬佩你这样认真保管记录。
乔：这些记录属于在这里帮忙的每个人。
玛雅：我怕受到责怪。
乔：比起完美表现，我们更需要诚实。人们信任我们，交给我们钱，诚信很重要。
玛雅：我会告诉下一位信封在哪里。
乔：那是尊重下一位负责人的交接方式。

readingBlocks.en: A newspaper cutting on the wall called the charity a respectable organisation. Jo said a good reputation was something it had to keep earning. Maya looked again at the small box and understood why even the empty forms mattered.
readingBlocks.zh: 墙上一张报纸剪贴称这家慈善机构是受人尊重的组织。乔说，好声誉需要持续用行动维护。玛雅再次看着那个小盒子，明白了为什么连空白表格也重要。

glossary.zh: 普通的；没有特别之处的
glossary.note: ordinary person/day/mistake；不等于错误无需处理。

externalEvidence.definition: not exceptional in any way especially in quality or ability or size or degree

glossary.note: 形容决定或做法合理；不是sensitive敏感的。
glossary.example: Checking the drawer first was a sensible suggestion.
glossary.exampleZh: 先检查抽屉是明智的建议。

glossary.note: for + 名词/doing；不是只在名义上负责。
glossary.example: Maya took responsibility for putting the envelope in the wrong place.
glossary.exampleZh: 玛雅为把信封放错地方承担责任。

glossary.note: 这里为及物动词；名词respect与方面义另待核对。
glossary.example: I respect how carefully you keep the records.
glossary.exampleZh: 我敬佩你这样认真保管记录。

glossary.zh: 诚实并坚持道德原则；诚信
glossary.note: 此处为人的品行，不是物体完整性。
glossary.example: Integrity matters when people trust us with their money.
glossary.exampleZh: 人们把钱交托给我们时，诚信很重要。

glossary.note: respectful of/to；表达行为对他人有尊重。
glossary.example: Her handover was respectful of the next volunteer’s time.
glossary.exampleZh: 她的交接考虑并尊重下一位志愿者的时间。

glossary.zh: 被认为品行或行为端正、值得尊重的
glossary.note: 此处为社会评价；不把respectable当作respectful行为尊重的同义词。
glossary.example: The newspaper described it as a respectable organisation.
glossary.exampleZh: 报纸称它是一家受人尊重的组织。

externalEvidence.label: Oxford Learner’s Dictionaries
externalEvidence.reviewFinding: Organisation worthy of respect; not merely respectable numeric result.
